# InsuredCan — Canada's Trusted Insurance Comparison Platform

> InsuredCan is a licensed Canadian insurance brokerage that helps families, newcomers, and self-employed Canadians find affordable life, health, critical illness, disability, travel, and mortgage protection insurance. We compare quotes from 20+ top Canadian insurers and provide free, unbiased advice from licensed advisors.

## About InsuredCan
- Licensed insurance brokerage operating across Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Quebec, and Manitoba
- Education-first approach with no-obligation free quotes
- Over 5,000 Canadian families protected
- Compares plans from 20+ insurers including Sun Life, Manulife, Canada Life, Desjardins, and more

## Insurance Products

### Life Insurance
- [Life Insurance Guide](https://www.insuredcan.ca/life-insurance): Complete guide to term, whole, and universal life insurance in Canada
- [Term Life Insurance](https://www.insuredcan.ca/term-life-insurance): Affordable coverage for 10, 20, or 30 year terms
- [Whole Life Insurance](https://www.insuredcan.ca/whole-life-insurance): Permanent coverage with cash value accumulation
- [Funeral Insurance](https://www.insuredcan.ca/funeral-insurance): Final expense coverage for Canadians

### Health & Protection
- [Critical Illness Insurance](https://www.insuredcan.ca/critical-illness-insurance): Lump-sum benefit upon diagnosis of covered conditions
- [Disability Insurance](https://www.insuredcan.ca/disability-insurance): Income replacement if you can't work due to illness or injury
- [Health Insurance](https://www.insuredcan.ca/health-insurance): Extended health coverage beyond provincial plans
- [Travel Insurance](https://www.insuredcan.ca/travel-insurance): Medical and trip protection for Canadian travellers

### Financial Protection
- [Mortgage Insurance](https://www.insuredcan.ca/mortgage-insurance): Protect your family's home
- [Retirement Planning](https://www.insuredcan.ca/retirement-planning): Insurance strategies for retirement income
